plainText:
Tetsu Inada (Japanese: 稲田徹 Inada Tetsu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Inada was born on July 1, 1972, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He voiced one of his best-known roles as Pastoria City Gym Leader Crasher Wake, during of the . He later voiced Matt in Pokémon Generations. Inada is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
